'''Satin Creditcare Network Limited''' is a non-banking finance company ([[Non-bank financial institution|NBFC]]), licensed by the [[Reserve Bank of India]]. It was founded in 1990 by Mr. H P Singh.<ref>{{cite web |title=SATIN Share Price - 328.20 INR, Satin Creditcare Network stock price today, Live updates |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/satin-creditcare-network-ltd/stocks/companyid-5590.cms |accessdate=16 March 2019}}</ref> The company's offers financial requirements for excluded households at the bottom of the pyramid. Satin Creditcare Network Limited is a micro-finance institution (MFI) in the country with presence in 7 states and more than 12,00 villages.

== History ==
The company launched its operations as a provider of individual and small business loans and savings services to urban lenders in 1990, going on to be registered as an NBFC with the [[Reserve Bank of India|RBI]] in 1998 and converting into an [[NBFC]]-[[Microfinance institution|MFI]] in November 2013. Founded by HP Singh who has over three decades of micro-finance experience.{{citation needed|date=February 2020}}

In 2017, company incorporated a wholly owned Housing Finance subsidiary with the aim of providing financing in the affordable housing segment and leveraging rural outreach.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.entrepreneur.com/article/315653|title=This Microfinance Institution Wants to Help Rural Indian Women to Fulfill their Dreams of Entrepreneurship|last=Marya|first=Ritu|date=2018-06-25|website=Entrepreneur|language=en|access-date=2019-03-26}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/videos/finance/satin-creditcare-to-focus-on-rural-space-for-housing-portfolio-518041.htm|title=Satin Creditcare to focus on rural space for housing portfolio|website=cnbctv18.com|date=14 August 2018 |language=en-US|access-date=2019-03-26}}</ref> In January 2019, company received separate NBFC license to commence MSME business "Satin Finserv Limited".<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/satin-creditcare-to-create-separate-subsidiary-for-sme-business-cmd/article25843368.ece|title=Satin Creditcare to create separate subsidiary for SME business: CMD|last=Roy|first=Shobha|website=@businessline|date=27 December 2018 |language=en|access-date=2019-03-26}}</ref> SATIN forayed in digital lending "Loan Dost".<ref>{{Cite news |last=Market |first=Capital |date=2018-11-28 |title=Satin Creditcare Network launches mobile app - Loan Dost |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/satin-creditcare-network-launches-mobile-app-loan-dost-118112800297_1.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181128085556/https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/satin-creditcare-network-launches-mobile-app-loan-dost-118112800297_1.html |archive-date=2018-11-28 |work=[[Business_Standard]]}}</ref>

As of March 2019, SCNL had 1,168 branches and a headcount of 11,940 across 22 states and union territories serving 35 lakh clients.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://satincreditcare.com/at-a-glance/|title=At A Glance – SATIN CREDITCARE NETWORK LTD.|language=en-US|access-date=2019-03-26}}</ref> Satin Creditcare maintains a focus on rural and semi-urban areas.<ref>{{Cite web |last=India |first=Mfin |date=2021-05-07 |title=Satin Creditcare: Transforming lives through microfinance |url=https://mfinindia.org/assets/upload_image/news/pdf/Satin%20Creditcare%20Transforming%20lives%20through%20microfinance-%20Press%20Release.pdf |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210507124440/https://mfinindia.org/assets/upload_image/news/pdf/Satin%20Creditcare%20Transforming%20lives%20through%20microfinance-%20Press%20Release.pdf |archive-date=2021-05-07 |access-date=2024-06-14 |website=[[MicroFinance_Institutions_Network]]}}</ref>

== The 1 billion mark ==

SATIN reached the US$1-Billion Asset Under Management mark at the close of FY2018–19.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Satin Creditcare Network Chairman Speech {{!}} Latest speech by Chairman of Satin Creditcare Network |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/satin-creditcare-network-ltd/chairmanspeech/companyid-5590.cms |access-date=2022-04-14 |website=The Economic Times}}</ref>

This differential is also manifest in its faster-than-industry growth in the last five years – they posted CAGR growth of 37.3% from FY15 to FY19, as against industry growth of 25.6%. <ref>{{Cite web |last=Ratings) |first=India Ratings and Research Private Limited(India |title=India Ratings and Research: Credit Rating and Research Agency India |url=https://www.indiaratings.co.in/pressrelease/37542 |access-date=2024-06-14 |website=www.indiaratings.co.in |language=en}}</ref>

== Subsidiaries ==

=== Satin Housing Finance Limited ===
Incorporated on 17 April 2017, It was founded by Mr. Amit Sharma (CEO & MD - Satin Housing Finance Limited) as a wholly owned subsidiary company of Satin Creditcare Network Limited, Satin Housing Finance Limited has a registered office in [[New Delhi]]. Satin Housing Finance Limited provides long-term finance for the purchase, construction, extension and repair of houses for the retail segment, along with loans against a residential property, commercial property and plots.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/videos/finance/satin-creditcare-to-focus-on-rural-space-for-housing-portfolio-518041.htm|title=Satin Creditcare to focus on rural space for housing portfolio|website=cnbctv18.com|date=14 August 2018 |language=en-US|access-date=2019-04-24}}</ref>

=== TARAASHNA ===
Taraashna Financial Services Limited acts as a business correspondent for banks and [[NBFC]]s and provides similar services to other financial institutions in rural and semi-urban areas. Taraashna Financial Services Limited is enabled under its objects to carry out the business of, among other things, the promotion and nurturing of SBL, Cattle Finance, and JLG and providing them with capacity-building support, as well as linking them to banks and other financial institutions in order to avail different financial services.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/satin-creditcare-plans-to-launch-mfi-business-in-tamil-nadu-next-month/article24988195.ece|title=Satin Creditcare plans to launch MFI business in Tamil Nadu next month|last=Surabhi|website=@businessline|date=19 September 2018 |language=en|access-date=2019-04-24}}</ref>

=== Satin Finserv Limited ===
Satin Creditcare Network Limited forayed into the [[MSME]] segment with a focus on small business owners in manufacturing, trading and services. The company's [[MSME]] loan offerings to these customers account for the fact that many of these customers may not habitually maintain standard books of accounts, or that a vast majority of them may not even fall under the turnover bracket warranting financial auditing.
<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/finance/micro-finance-company-satin-to-hive-off-its-msme-lending-business-118090400744_1.html|title=Micro finance company Satin to hive off its MSME lending business|last=Dhasmana|first=Indivjal|date=2018-09-04|work=Business Standard India|access-date=2019-04-24}}</ref>
